title: Redirection of the UE by the core network

entities.name: Redirection from EPC to 5GCN
entities.description: Network procedure to redirect a UE from EPC to 5GCN by rejecting certain NAS requests with EMM cause #31. The network considers UE capabilities and CIoT network behavior preferences.

entities.name: Redirection from 5GCN to EPC
entities.description: Network procedure to redirect a UE from 5GCN to EPC as specified in TS 24.501 for networks supporting CIoT optimizations.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that can be rejected by network to trigger redirection to 5GCN.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that can be rejected by network to trigger redirection to 5GCN.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that can be rejected by network to trigger redirection to 5GCN.

entities.name: EMM cause #31
entities.description: EMM cause value 'Redirection to 5GCN required' used in reject messages to trigger UE redirection.

entities.name: UE capability considerations
entities.description: Network considers UE's N1 mode capability, S1 mode capability, and CIoT network behavior preferences when determining redirection.

entities.name: Disable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: UE behavior to disable E-UTRA capability upon receiving redirection reject message.

entities.name: Enable N1 mode capability
entities.description: UE behavior to enable N1 mode capability if it was disabled, to facilitate movement to 5GCN.
